title: Release-train cadence & decision ladder for API / Console / Runtime sync
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: Define a pragmatic, stakeholder-aligned release-train cadence and decision ladder for coordinated launches across Redwood API, Console, and Serving Runtime. This ticket yields: 1) milestone calendar for a 6-week train, 2) explicit scope-lock and cut thresholds per component, 3) gating metrics and automated rollback triggers, and 4) a runbook for release-day comms and fallbacks. Scope includes hosted API surface changes, Console UX flows for rollout toggles, and runtime kernel/quantization changes that affect P99/P95 latency and unit cost. Out of scope: pricing changes, long-term contract/legal signoff steps (handled by Enterprise Ops).
progress_updates: 2026-02-10 - Created: initial draft milestone calendar and stakeholder list (PM/Eng/Design/Support/Sales). Assigned owners for each milestone.

2026-02-17 - Cross-functional sync: Eng requested a 1-week freeze on runtime kernel changes before canary due to compatibility risk; Design asked for a late-add window for console strings. Action: updated milestone to include a hard freeze and a one-day localization pass.

2026-02-24 - Engineering review: proposed gating metrics refined to include runtime p95, API error-rate (5xx per minute), console e2e regression tests passing, and canary customer-facing telemetry. Security reviewed KMS implications; no block but recommended key-rotation checklist.

2026-03-04 - Legal/Compliance note: Private deployment customers require a separate comms path; added a parallel signoff node for Private release lane. Added separate cut criteria for Private (audit log validation).

2026-03-09 - Canary dry run: Canary for API/Console passed functional checks but runtime GPU scheduler showed elevated latency under batching pattern A. Eng opened ENG-19872 to investigate backpressure. Decision: proceed with limited canary (10% traffic) and monitor until ENG fix lands.
2026-03-12 - PM gating review: confirmed cut thresholds and rollback thresholds. Preparing release notes template and communication schedule for launch week.
decisions: Adopt 6-week release train with three milestone gates: Alpha (feature complete), Freeze (scope lock), Canary (progressive rollout).
Scope lock applies at Freeze gate: only critical bug fixes allowed after Freeze; all feature flags must be testable in staging.
Cut criteria: runtime p95 increase <= 20% relative to baseline AND API 5xx rate < 0.2% over 30m window; otherwise block promotion to Canary.
Automated rollback triggers: sustained API 5xx > 0.5% for 10 minutes OR runtime p95 > 50% above baseline for 5 minutes => immediate rollback and incident page.
Console rollouts gated by e2e regression pass and localization sanity; Console changes will be toggled server-side for quick rollback.
Private deployment lane will follow same cadence but requires audit-log verification and customer opt-in; separate cut date 3 days after hosted rollout.
Design agreed to reduced copy freeze window (48 hours) before Freeze gate to allow urgent microcopy fixes with PM signoff.
